component.name: T3 Code (Flatpak)
component.summary: Work with coding agents on your machine

description.p: An unofficial Flatpak package for T3 Code. The desktop runs inside Flatpak and starts its matching T3 server on the host, where coding agents can use your projects and development tools.
Find and open installed Flatpak editors, including Zed, from the Open in menu.
Run the host server directly from the installed Flatpak package, avoiding a runtime copy on each launch. T3 Code data stays in the app's Flatpak directory.
